items.a: The Memory is a platform for building online memories for the people you love. You gather photos, messages, music and even a secret PIN into a single link, and send it to them. It works for any occasion — a surprise for your partner, an anniversary, a birthday, an apology, or simply telling your family you love them.

items.q: Is it hard? How long does it take?
items.a: Not hard at all. Three steps: 1) create a memory, 2) add photos, messages or music, 3) share the link. No app to install, and most people are done in under 5 minutes.

items.q: How much does it cost? Can I build it for free?
items.a: Building and previewing is completely free. When you're happy with it, you pay ฿99 to activate the link and share it. It's yours to keep, and you can send it as many times as you like.
Completely. We use Stripe, the same payment provider trusted by Shopify, Amazon and companies worldwide. Credit and debit cards and PromptPay are supported.

items.q: Does the person receiving it need an account?
items.a: No. They tap the link and it opens — on a phone or a laptop. No app, no signup, nothing to install.

items.q: Can I lock it with a password?
items.a: Yes. Add a 6-digit PIN and they'll have to enter it before they can see what's next. It's a great way to build a little suspense.
